relationships.subject: IL-1β
relationships.evidence_quote: IL-1ß stimulation significantly enhanced the release of PGE-2 in hAFCs CM

relationships.subject: celecoxib
relationships.evidence_quote: Cxb can inhibit PGE-2 production in hAFCs in an IL-1β-induced pro-inflammatory in vitro environment.

relationships.subject: celecoxib
relationships.evidence_quote: The cxb applied to the hAFCs also reduces the sensitization of DRG nociceptors that are stimulated by the hAFCs CM.

key_findings: Celecoxib suppresses IL-1β-induced PGE2 release from annulus fibrosus cells and reduces bradykinin-evoked DRG sensitization by their conditioned medium.
